units.text: Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, from the tribe of Judah, Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to the voice of the Lord their God and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him to them. The people feared before the Lord.
Haggai, the messenger of the Lord, said to the people, “I am with you, says the Lord.”

The Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, from the tribe of Judah, the spirit of Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the remnant of all the people. They came in and were carrying out work on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God,
on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year under King Darius.
But it is not as though God’s word has failed. For not all who are from Israel are Israel;
neither, because they are Abraham’s seed, are they all children; but, “In Isaac your seed will be called.”
That is, the children of the flesh are not thereby God’s children, but the children of the promise are reckoned as seed.
For this is a word of promise: “At this time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
And not only this, but also Rebecca, having conceived by one man, Isaac our father—
for when they had not yet been born or done anything good or bad, so that God’s purpose according to election might remain,
not from works but from the One who calls, it was said to her, “The older will serve the younger,”
just as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
And Isaac prayed to the Lord concerning Rebekah his wife, because she was barren; and God heard him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
And the children leaped within her; and she said, “If it is to be this way with me, why is this happening to me?” And she went to inquire of the Lord.
And the Lord said to her, “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples shall be separated from within you; and one people shall surpass the other, and the greater shall serve the lesser.”
And her days to give birth were fulfilled, and behold, there were twins in her womb.
And the firstborn son came out red, all over like a hairy hide; and he was named Esau.
And afterward his brother came out, and his hand held Esau’s heel; and he was named Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah bore them.
On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy the wise from Idumea and understanding from Mount Esau.
Your warriors from Teman will be terrified, so that a person may be removed from Mount Esau,
because of the slaughter and the impiety toward your brother Jacob; and shame will cover you, and you will be removed forever.
Her ravines will turn to pitch, her earth to sulfur, and her land will burn like pitch
night and day. It will not be quenched for an everlasting time, and her smoke will rise upward. For generations and a long time she will be deserted.
Birds, hedgehogs, ibises and ravens will dwell in her; a measuring cord for deserted land will be cast upon her, and donkey-centaurs will dwell in her.
Her rulers will be no more, for her kings, her rulers and her magnates will come to destruction.
Thorny trees will sprout in their cities and her fortifications; she will become a dwelling for sirens and a courtyard for ostriches.
Demons will meet donkey-centaurs and cry one to another. There donkey-centaurs will rest, for they found rest for themselves.
There a hedgehog nested, and the earth kept her children safe. There deer met and saw one another’s faces;
Make music to our God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
For God is King of all the earth; make music with understanding.
God reigned over the nations; God sits upon His holy throne.
The rulers of peoples gathered with Abraham’s God; for the mighty of the earth belong to God; they were greatly exalted.
Listen, heaven, and give ear, earth, because the Lord has spoken: “I begot sons and raised them high, but they rejected Me.
An ox knew the one who acquired it, and a donkey its lord’s manger; but Israel did not know Me, and the people did not understand Me.”
Woe, sinful nation, people full of sins, evil offspring, lawless sons! You abandoned the Lord and provoked the Holy One of Israel to anger.
Honour your father and your mother, that it may be well with you, and that your days may be long upon the good land which the Lord your God gives you.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
Tell Aaron and his sons to exercise care concerning the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they consecrate to Me, and not profane My holy name. I am the Lord.

Say unto them: Throughout your generations, any man of all your seed who draws near unto the holy things which the sons of Israel consecrate unto the Lord, while his uncleanness is upon him, that soul shall be destroyed from before Me; I am the Lord your God.

And any man among the seed of Aaron the priest who has leprosy or a seminal discharge shall not eat the holy things until he is cleansed. Nor shall one who touches any uncleanness of a person, or a man from whom an emission of semen goes out,
or anyone who touches any unclean creeping creature that defiles him, or a human being who defiles him through any uncleanness of his.
The soul that touches them shall be unclean until evening; he shall not eat of the holy things unless he has bathed his body in water;
and when the sun sets, he shall be clean; afterward he may eat the holy things, for they are his bread.
He shall not eat an animal found dead or torn by beasts, becoming unclean through them. I am the Lord.
And they shall keep My requirements, so that they do not incur sin through them and die through them if they profane them. I am the Lord God who sanctifies them.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:

Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons and unto all the congregation of Israel, and you shall say unto them: Any man of the sons of Israel, or of the sons of the resident foreigners attached unto them in Israel, who presents his gifts according to any of their pledges or any of their freewill offerings, which they present unto God for a whole burnt offering,
to be acceptable for you, they shall be males without blemish, from the cattle, the sheep, or the goats.
They shall not bring anything with a blemish unto the Lord, for it will not be acceptable for you.

And if a man presents a sacrifice of deliverance unto the Lord, specifying a vow by voluntary choice or at your feasts, from the cattle or the sheep, it shall be unblemished to be accepted; there shall be no blemish in it.

They shall not bring unto the Lord an animal that is blind, crushed, has its tongue cut, has warts, a severe scab, or skin eruptions. You shall not place any of these on the altar as an offering unto the Lord.
And you may slaughter for yourself a calf or a sheep with a cut-off ear or a shortened tail; but for your vow it shall not be accepted.
You shall not bring unto the Lord an animal castrated by crushing, or by squeezing out, or by cutting out, or by tearing away; and in your land you shall not do this.
And you shall not present any of these as the gifts of your God from the hand of a foreigner, for there are corruptions in them; they have a blemish. These will not be accepted for you.
Hear the Lord’s word, rulers of Sodom! Attend to God’s law, people of Gomorrah!
“What is the multitude of your sacrifices to Me?” says the Lord. “I am full of burnt offerings of rams; fat of lambs and blood of bulls and male goats I do not desire,
not even if you come to appear before Me. For who demanded these things from your hands? To trample My court,
you will no longer continue. If you bring fine flour, it is futile. Incense is an abomination to Me. Your new moons and sabbaths and a great day I cannot endure; fasting and idleness,
and your new moons and your festivals My soul hates. You have become more than enough for Me; I will no longer let your sins go.
Whenever you stretch your hands toward Me, I will turn My eyes away from you. Even if you multiply supplication, I will not listen to you, for your hands are full of blood.
Wash yourselves, become clean. Remove the evils from your souls, before My eyes. Stop your evil deeds.
Learn to do good, seek judgment, rescue the wronged. Give judgment for the orphan and vindicate the widow.
Hallelujah! Praise the Lord, servants; praise the name of the Lord.
May the name of the Lord be blessed from now and for ever.
From the sun’s risings to its settings, praise the name of the Lord.
